diagrams, and skill-requirements entries.

  schematic-generator drift check it also held into schematic.py.

  plus the bundled pdf_to_images.py and validate_presentation.py.
- liteparse and markitdown point PDF manipulation at pypdf.
- Update skill counts to 177 across README and docs, remove the skills from
  the catalog, guide index, and workflow examples, and prune them from the
  security report.
